31d3bb0.summary: Builds and shows the disconnection popup. Called when a player loses connection; the text names the local player or the opponent, and for the local player a wait-for-connection line is added. Sets isPlayer and opens the popup through WindowsManager.
comments: remember whether the local player (true) or the opponent was the one who disconnected
pick which localized label field to read: offset 0x30 for the local player, 0x48 for the opponent
copy the chosen localized string (3 fields) into temporaries for appending
append the disconnection message, with null checks on the builder
local player only: also add the 'waiting for connection' line
build the final text and show it in a popup via the WindowsManager
reached only if a null check failed
